newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.lead: Scholarship deadlines, new programs, open days and visa updates — about twice a month.
newsletter.consent: I want to receive GEC's newsletter by e-mail. I can unsubscribe at any time.
newsletter.consent_required: Please tick the box to subscribe.
newsletter.footer_title: Study abroad news in your inbox
newsletter.footer_text: Scholarship deadlines, new programs and open days. Twice a month, no spam.
newsletter.footer_consent: We send a confirmation e-mail first. Unsubscribe any time.
newsletter.sent_text: We sent you an e-mail with a confirmation button. Your subscription starts once you confirm.
newsletter.confirm_text: One click and you're on the list.
newsletter.confirmed_text: Thank you! The next newsletter is on its way. Every e-mail has an unsubscribe link.
newsletter.unsub_text: You will not receive the newsletter any more.
newsletter.invalid_text: Subscribe again and we'll send a fresh confirmation link.
newsletter.mail_title: Confirm your subscription to GEC news
newsletter.mail_body:
Hello {name},

Please confirm that you want to receive GEC's newsletter: scholarship deadlines, new programs and open days.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this e-mail and nothing will be sent.
newsletter.audience_hint: Newsletter subscribers: confirmed (double opt-in) e-mail addresses; filter by country interest and degree.
newsletter.staff_lead: People who subscribed on the website and confirmed by e-mail. Send them a campaign with the “Newsletter subscribers” audience.
newsletter.none: No subscribers yet. The sign-up form is in the website footer and at /newsletter.

utm.lead: Build tracked links for social posts, ads, WhatsApp broadcasts and flyers, and see how many visitors, leads and students each one brings.
utm.name: Link name
utm.url_hint: A page on the website (/programs?country=GB) or a full address.
utm.source_hint: Where the click comes from: instagram, google, flyer.
utm.medium_hint: The type of traffic: social, cpc, email, offline.
utm.content_hint: Optional: which post or ad version.
utm.saved: Link created — copy it from the list.
utm.delete_confirm: Delete this link? Its results stay in analytics.
utm.results_hint: Visitors are counted only for people who accepted analytics cookies; leads and students come from the source recorded on their first visit.
